senses.gloss:
mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Purgative, aperient.
m. (-कः)
1 A cathartic, a purgative.
2 Nitre, saltpetre.
3 The purging-nut plant, (Croton tiglium.)
n. (-कं)
A purge.
E.
रिच् to evacuate by stool, causal form, वुन् aff.

nf. (-नं-ना)
Purging, looseness.
f. (-ना-नी)
A drug, commonly Śuṇḍārocanī.
f. (-नी)
1 A plant, Tëori, (Convolvulus turpethum,) the white sort.
2 Another plant, commonly Danti, (Croton polyandrum.)
E.
रिच to purge, aff. ल्युट् or युच्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Left void or empty, freed from, cleared.
2 Purged.
E.
रिच to purge, क्त aff.
